scope: Independent replay of the four archived finding classifications, not arbitrary SPARQL or upstream source truth.

arithmetic.window_return: Archived builder sums supplied daily returns in percent when available and otherwise falls back to endpoint price change; it does not compound supplied returns.
arithmetic.event_return: Archived cumulative abnormal return % label sums supplied event daily_return cells without benchmark subtraction in the builder. IDX acquisition supplies ordinary company returns; PSX/MSX upstream interpretation is unverified.
arithmetic.correlation: Pearson coefficient over builder-matched daily series; R2 is a classification, not the complete CQ2 answer.

R2.limitation: Does not evaluate full CQ2 benchmark correlation and FX change.

R3.predicate: company > sector + margin AND company > benchmark + margin

R4.evidence_policy: One passing branch is sufficient. Both available branches are contextual completeness, not a requirement for sufficiency.

CQ5.policy: Expose deciding witness observations separately from contextual observations. Missing inputs are incomplete, never zero. Source linkage follows actual prov:wasDerivedFrom edges; it does not certify source truth. Missing graph unit declarations remain unverified.
